# RaggieSoft Installer Studio — Complete `.rsip`, `.rsis` & `.rsii` Reference (v0.2.1)

Generated deterministically by `RaggieSoft Installer Studio (instbuild.exe 0.2.1) --emit-ai-spec`.

## 1. Architectural Rules
1. **Native MSI, MSM, MST, MSP & SetupWizard.exe Output**: Calls `msiquery.h` (`msi.lib`) and `fci.h` (`Cabinet.lib`) directly from static `/MT` C++20.
2. **100% White-Label Attribution**: Visible dialogs and `Setup.exe` `VERSIONINFO` use `[Package] Manufacturer` and `Name` exclusively; `RaggieSoft Installer Studio (instbuild.exe 0.2.1)` is recorded solely in MSI `SummaryInformation` `PID_APPNAME`.
3. **Hybrid `.rsip` + `.rsis` + `.rsii` Model**: Build a single `.rsip` standalone, share common blocks via `@include "common.rsii"`, or orchestrate multi-package fleets via `.rsis`.
4. **Deterministic SHA-1 UUIDv5 Component GUIDs**: Derived from `UpgradeCode + arch + targetRelPath`.
5. **True OS & Silicon Detection**: `RtlGetVersion` (`Build >= 22000`) + `IsWow64Process2` (pierces ARM64 Prism emulation).
6. **Lossless AST Comments**: `;` and `#` comments plus `@include` directives survive `InstallerStudio.exe` GUI edits byte-for-byte.

## 2. Complete `.rsip` Project Schema (`v0.3`)

### `[Package]` (*Required*)
Core product identity, MSI Summary Information, target CPU architecture (x64/arm64), and output settings.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `SchemaVersion` | `string` | No | `0.3` | Manifest grammar version (`0.3`). |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Consumer-facing ProductName written to MSI Property table and VERSIONINFO. |
| `Version` | `msi_version (Major.Minor.Build)` | **Yes** | — | Three-part Windows Installer version (`Major.Minor.Build`, max `255.255.65535`). |
| `Manufacturer` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Publisher name written to MSI `Manufacturer` property and VERSIONINFO `CompanyName`. |
| `UpgradeCode` | `guid ({XXXXXXXX-...})` | **Yes** | — | Permanent `{GUID}` shared across all releases of this product for Major Upgrades and UUIDv5 seeding. |
| `ProductCode` | `guid_or_auto ('*' or {GUID})` | No | `*` | `*` generates a fresh ProductCode GUID on each build, or specify an explicit `{GUID}`. |
| `Description` | `string` | No | — | Summary Information description and Setup.exe `FileDescription`. |
| `Language` | `integer` | No | `1033` | Numeric Windows LCID (`1033` = English - United States). |
| `Architecture` | `enum` | No | `arm64` | Allowed: `x64|arm64`. Target silicon (`x64` -> `x64;1033`, `arm64` -> `Arm64;1033`). Overridable via `--arch=<x64|arm64>`. |
| `Scope` | `enum` | No | `machine` | Allowed: `machine|user`. `machine` (`ALLUSERS=1`, `ProgramFiles64Folder`) or `user` (per-user `LocalAppDataFolder`, zero UAC). |
| `OutputName` | `string` | No | — | Base filename stem (supports `$(ARCH)`); defaults to `<kebab-name>-$(ARCH)`. |
| `OutputDir` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | `out` | Output folder for `<OutputName>.msi` and `<OutputName>-setup.exe` (relative to `.rsip` folder or absolute). |
| `BuildBootstrapper` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | When `true`, emits branded `<OutputName>-setup.exe` embedding `Product.msi` alongside the standalone `.msi`. |
| `CabinetCompression` | `enum` | No | `lzx` | Allowed: `lzx|mszip`. Compression algorithm for embedded `#payload.cab` (`lzx` = high-ratio LZX:21, `mszip` = fast DEFLATE). |
| `HideFromInstalledApps` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT=1` so content micro-installers do not clutter Windows Installed Apps. |
| `AboutUrl` | `string` | No | — | Optional support/product website URL written to `ARPURLINFOABOUT`. |
| `PackageKind` | `enum` | No | `msi` | Allowed: `msi|msm`. `msi` builds a standalone Enterprise `.msi` (+ optional `-setup.exe`); `msm` builds a reusable Merge Module (`.msm`). |
| `Tagline` | `string` | No | — | Short subtitle displayed beneath the product title in `SetupWizard.exe` and `InstallerStudio.exe`. |
| `WebsiteLabel` | `string` | No | — | Optional domain badge shown in the setup wizard footer (left blank if omitted — 100% white-label!). |

### `[Requirements]` (*Optional*)
Minimum Windows 11 build gate (RtlGetVersion & MSI LaunchCondition) and downgrade protection.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `MinWindowsBuild` | `integer` | No | `22000` | Minimum Windows 10/11 build number (`22000` = Windows 11 21H2+, matching .NET 10 Desktop Runtime). |
| `OsLaunchMessage` | `string` | No | `This application requires Windows 11 (Build 22000) or later.` | Friendly message shown by LaunchCondition / SetupWizard.exe when the host OS is older than MinWindowsBuild. |
| `BlockDowngrades` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Adds a newer-version Upgrade row + LaunchCondition preventing accidental downgrades. |

### `[Install]` (*Required*)
Default installation subfolder under ProgramFiles64Folder/LocalAppDataFolder and Start Menu group.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `DefaultSubdir` | `relpath` | **Yes** | — | Default target folder path under `ProgramFiles64Folder` (or `LocalAppDataFolder`), e.g. `MyCompany\MyApp`. |
| `StartMenuFolder` | `relpath` | No | — | Program Menu subfolder name created when `[Shortcut.*]` targets `StartMenu` (defaults to `[Package] Manufacturer`). |
| `MainExecutable` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional primary `.exe` relative to `INSTALLDIR` (used for `ARPPRODUCTICON` default & Finish launch). |

### `[UI]` (*Optional*)
Branding, RTF license, icon, C++ Glass layout, and MSI.DLL Express/Custom dialog workflow preset.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `LicenseRtf` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional `.rtf` license file displayed in Wizard 97 `LicenseAgreementDlg` and `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `IconFile` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional `.ico` file embedded into MSI `Icon` table (`ARPPRODUCTICON`) and `Setup.exe` resources. |
| `BannerTitle` | `string` | No | — | Optional subtitle displayed in the wizard header bar. |
| `WelcomeHeadline` | `string` | No | — | Optional custom headline on the Welcome screen. |
| `InstallButtonText` | `accel_string (must include '&')` | No | `&Install` | Accessible primary install button caption; MUST include a `&` keyboard mnemonic. |
| `FinishLaunchCheckbox` | `accel_string (must include '&')` | No | `&Launch application when setup finishes` | Accessible finish-screen launch checkbox caption; MUST include a `&` keyboard mnemonic. |
| `OfferLaunchOnFinish` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Shows the optional launch checkbox on the completion screen when `MainExecutable` is set. |
| `WizardLayout` | `enum` | No | `standard` | Allowed: `standard|aerowizard|autorun16x9`. `standard` shows the RaggieSoft Glass Setup Wizard; `aerowizard` uses modern Windows AeroWizard chrome with top-left DWM Back glyph; `autorun16x9` shows the 640x480 16:9 Autorun stage. |
| `MsiDialogPreset` | `enum` | No | `express_custom` | Allowed: `express_custom|minimal`. `express_custom` builds the full Express / Compact / Custom + SelectionTree + BrowseDlg + Shortcuts + Office Repair Mode workflow inside MSI.DLL's Dialog table; `minimal` builds a compact 3-screen MSI UI. |
| `AccentPrimaryHex` | `string` | No | `#2563EB` | Primary header accent hex color (e.g. `#2563EB` Cobalt, `#38BDF8` Sky Cyan, `#14B8A6` Teal). |
| `AccentSecondaryHex` | `string` | No | `#FBBF24` | Secondary gradient accent hex color (e.g. `#FBBF24` Warm Gold, `#10B981` Emerald, `#EC4899` Rose). |
| `ArtworkPng` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional `.png` 16:9 banner or square product/album/book cover rendered inside `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `WelcomeIntro` | `string` | No | — | Optional introductory paragraph displayed beneath the Hero Brand Card on the Welcome page of `SetupWizard.exe`. |
| `ReadMeText` | `string` | No | — | Optional edition liner notes or ReadMe summary displayed in the ReadMe view of `autorun16x9` installers. |
| `ExpressDescription` | `string` | No | `One-click setup into the default installation folder with recommended shortcuts. Skips extra prompts.` | Helper caption for the Express Setup mode card in `SetupWizard.exe` and MSI `SetupTypeDlg`. |
| `CompactDescription` | `string` | No | `Installs essential core application files (`Level = 1`) with minimal disk footprint.` | Helper caption for the Compact Core Setup mode card in `SetupWizard.exe` and MSI `SetupTypeDlg`. |
| `CustomDescription` | `string` | No | `Choose a custom destination folder, features, Start Menu group, and shortcuts step by step.` | Helper caption for the Custom Setup mode card in `SetupWizard.exe` and MSI `SetupTypeDlg`. |
| `AuthorOrArtist` | `string` | No | — | Optional author or band credit badge displayed in `autorun16x9` book/album micro-installers. |

### `[Signing]` (*Optional*)
Optional dual-layer Authenticode code signing (Product.msi first, then outer Setup.exe) via signtool.exe.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Enabled` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Signs `Product.msi` first, embeds it into `Setup.exe`, and signs `Setup.exe` via `signtool.exe`. |
| `Thumbprint` | `string` | No | — | Optional SHA-1 certificate thumbprint in the local Windows Certificate Store. |
| `TimestampUrl` | `string` | No | `http://timestamp.acs.microsoft.com` | RFC 3161 Authenticode timestamp server URL. |
| `DlibPath` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional path to Azure Artifact Signing `Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll`. |
| `MetadataJson` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | No | — | Optional path to Azure Artifact Signing metadata `.json` file. |

### `[Feature.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Named MSI Feature or Sub-Feature ([Feature.<id>]); defaults to a single 'Main' feature if omitted.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Title` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Consumer-facing title of this MSI Feature. |
| `Description` | `string` | No | — | Plain-English description of this MSI Feature shown in SelectionTree. |
| `Level` | `integer` | No | `1` | MSI InstallLevel (`1` = core/Compact & Express, `2..100` = Express/Custom optional, `0` = hidden). |
| `Parent` | `string` | No | — | Optional parent Feature ID (`Feature_Parent`) creating a hierarchical sub-feature in `SelectionTree`. |

### `[Component.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Explicit MSI Component ([Component.<id>]) enforcing Microsoft Single-Directory & KeyPath rules (File, Registry, or CreateFolder).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this Component in `FeatureComponents`. |
| `TargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `INSTALLDIR` | Allowed: `INSTALLDIR|CommonFiles64Folder|CommonAppDataFolder|AppDataFolder|LocalAppDataFolder|ProgramMenuFolder|ApplicationProgramsFolder|DesktopFolder|System64Folder|FontsFolder`. Single Windows Installer root directory for this Component (Microsoft Single-Directory Component Rule). |
| `TargetSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional subdirectory under `TargetRoot` where all files of this Component reside. |
| `Guid` | `guid_or_auto ('*' or {GUID})` | No | `*` | `*` computes a deterministic SHA-1 UUIDv5 ComponentId, or specify an explicit `{GUID}`. |
| `KeyPathKind` | `enum` | No | `auto` | Allowed: `auto|file|registry|folder`. KeyPath resource type required by Windows Installer (`file` = File table key, `registry` = Registry key per ICE38, `folder` = NULL KeyPath + CreateFolder per ICE18). |
| `KeyPathTarget` | `string` | No | — | Target filename (when `KeyPathKind = file`) or `[Registry.<id>]` section ID (when `KeyPathKind = registry`). |
| `Condition` | `string` | No | — | Optional MSI install condition evaluated during `CostFinalize` (e.g. `DESKTOP_SHORTCUT = "1"`). |
| `Permanent` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbComponentAttributesPermanent` (`16`) so Windows Installer leaves this component on disk during uninstall. |
| `NeverOverwrite` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbComponentAttributesNeverOverwrite` (`128`) so existing user-modified config files/keys are never overwritten. |
| `SharedDllRefCount` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | Sets `msidbComponentAttributesSharedDllRefCount` (`8`) for legacy shared reference counting. |

### `[Folder.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Creates a destination subdirectory ([Folder.<id>]) via MSI CreateFolder + ICE64 RemoveFolder cleanup.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `TargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `INSTALLDIR` | Allowed: `INSTALLDIR|CommonFiles64Folder|CommonAppDataFolder|AppDataFolder|LocalAppDataFolder|ProgramMenuFolder|ApplicationProgramsFolder|DesktopFolder|System64Folder|FontsFolder`. Parent Windows Installer root folder (`INSTALLDIR`, `CommonAppDataFolder`, `AppDataFolder`, etc.). |
| `TargetSubdir` | `relpath` | **Yes** | — | Subfolder path to create under `TargetRoot` (e.g. `Logs` or `Plugins\Custom`). |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning the `CreateFolder` component. |
| `Component` | `string` | No | — | Optional `[Component.<id>]` name; auto-generates a `CreateFolder` component if omitted. |
| `RemoveOnUninstall` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Emits a `RemoveFile` (`InstallMode = 2`) row so empty folders are removed cleanly on uninstall (ICE64). |

### `[Payload.<id>]` (*Required*)
Maps a build-machine file or directory ([Payload.<id>]) into #payload.cab and deterministic or explicit MSI Components.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Source` | `path (supports $(ARCH))` | **Yes** | — | Source file or directory on the build machine (supports `$(ARCH)` expansion). |
| `TargetSubdir` | `relpath` | No | — | Optional destination subfolder inside `TargetRoot` (`""` = root of `TargetRoot`). |
| `Recursive` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Recursively includes subdirectories when `Source` points to a directory. |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning the generated file component(s). |
| `TargetRoot` | `enum` | No | `INSTALLDIR` | Allowed: `INSTALLDIR|CommonFiles64Folder|CommonAppDataFolder|AppDataFolder|LocalAppDataFolder|ProgramMenuFolder|ApplicationProgramsFolder|DesktopFolder|System64Folder|FontsFolder`. Destination MSI system folder root (`INSTALLDIR`, `CommonAppDataFolder`, `AppDataFolder`, `FontsFolder`, etc.). |
| `Component` | `string` | No | — | Optional `[Component.<id>]` name. When omitted, each file gets its own deterministic SHA-1 UUIDv5 Component & File KeyPath per Microsoft best practice. |

### `[FileAssociation.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Registers a file extension, ProgId, document icon, MIME type, and Explorer shell verbs ([FileAssociation.<id>]).

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Extension` | `string` | **Yes** | — | File extension to register (with or without leading dot, e.g. `.rsip` or `rsip`). |
| `ProgId` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Canonical programmatic identifier, e.g. `RaggieSoft.InstallerStudio.Project`. |
| `Description` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Human-friendly document type description displayed in Windows Explorer (e.g. `RaggieSoft Installer Project`). |
| `TargetFile` | `relpath` | **Yes** | — | Relative path under `INSTALLDIR` to the handler `.exe` packaged by `[Payload.*]`. |
| `Verbs` | `string` | No | `open:&Open:"%1"` | Pipe-separated shell verb definitions `verbId:MenuCaption:Arguments` (e.g. `open:&Open:"%1"|build:&Compile MSI:--build "%1"`). |
| `ContentType` | `string` | No | — | Optional MIME content type (e.g. `application/x-raggiesoft-rsip`). |
| `PerceivedType` | `string` | No | — | Optional Windows Explorer PerceivedType (`text`, `document`, `audio`, `image`, `video`). |
| `IconIndex` | `integer` | No | `0` | Zero-based icon resource index inside `TargetFile` (or `[UI] IconFile` when `Advertise = true`). |
| `Advertise` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `false` | `false` (default) writes clean `HKMU\Software\Classes` + `OpenWithProgids` keys with zero MSI self-repair popups; `true` populates native MSI `ProgId`, `Extension`, `Verb`, and `MIME` tables. |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this file association. |

### `[Shortcut.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Creates an advertised-free Start Menu or Desktop shortcut ([Shortcut.<id>]) with ICE38 HKCU KeyPath & ICE64 RemoveFolder.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Display name of the shortcut in Start Menu or Desktop. |
| `TargetFile` | `relpath` | **Yes** | — | Relative path under `INSTALLDIR` to the target executable packaged by `[Payload.*]`. |
| `Location` | `enum` | No | `StartMenu` | Allowed: `StartMenu|Desktop`. Where to place the shortcut (`StartMenu` or `Desktop`). |
| `Description` | `string` | No | — | Accessible screen-reader/tooltip description for the shortcut. |
| `Arguments` | `string` | No | — | Optional command-line arguments passed when the shortcut launches `TargetFile`. |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this shortcut. |

### `[Registry.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Writes an HKLM/HKCU/HKCR/HKMU registry value ([Registry.<id>]) tied to an auto or explicit 64-bit MSI Component.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Root` | `enum` | No | `HKLM` | Allowed: `HKLM|HKCU|HKCR|HKMU`. Registry hive (`HKLM` machine, `HKCU` user, `HKCR` classes, or `HKMU` auto-switching per `ALLUSERS`). |
| `Key` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Registry key path without hive prefix, e.g. `Software\RaggieSoft\MyApp`. |
| `Name` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Registry value name (use `@` for the key's default value). |
| `Value` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Registry value data (supports MSI formatted tokens like `[INSTALLDIR]` and `[ProductVersion]`). |
| `Type` | `enum` | No | `string` | Allowed: `string|expand_string|dword`. Registry value type (`string` = REG_SZ, `expand_string` = REG_EXPAND_SZ, `dword` = REG_DWORD). |
| `Feature` | `string` | No | `Main` | Feature ID owning this registry value. |
| `Component` | `string` | No | — | Optional `[Component.<id>]` owning this registry row (used when grouping registry values or setting a Registry KeyPath). |

### `[MsiDialog.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Defines a custom 370x270 Windows Installer SQL Dialog ([MsiDialog.<id>]) spliced into the MSI.DLL UI sequence.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Title` | `string` | No | `[ProductName] Setup` | Window caption bar title of this MSI Dialog. |
| `Width` | `integer` | No | `370` | Width in Windows Installer dialog units (standard Wizard 97 width is `370`). |
| `Height` | `integer` | No | `270` | Height in Windows Installer dialog units (standard Wizard 97 height is `270`). |
| `Banner` | `bool (true|false)` | No | `true` | Automatically adds standard Wizard 97 top `BannerBitmap`, `BannerLine`, `BottomLine`, and `Back`/`Next`/`Cancel` buttons. |
| `HeaderTitle` | `string` | No | `Custom Configuration` | Bold title text rendered inside the top 44-unit Wizard 97 banner. |
| `HeaderSubtitle` | `string` | No | — | Subtitle description rendered beneath `HeaderTitle` inside the top Wizard 97 banner. |
| `PrevDialog` | `string` | No | `SetupTypeDlg` | Previous dialog ID in the wizard chain (`< &Back` target and automatic forward splice point!). |
| `NextDialog` | `string` | No | `VerifyReadyDlg` | Next dialog ID opened when the user clicks `&Next >`. |

### `[MsiControl.<id>]` (*Optional*)
Adds a native MSI control ([MsiControl.<id>]: Text, Edit, CheckBox, RadioButtonGroup, etc.) to a new or built-in MSI Dialog.

| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed / Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `Dialog` | `string` | **Yes** | — | Target dialog ID (`[MsiDialog.<Dialog>]` or built-in dialog such as `SetupTypeDlg` or `VerifyReadyDlg`). |
| `Type` | `enum` | **Yes** | `Text` | Allowed: `Text|Edit|MaskedEdit|PathEdit|CheckBox|RadioButtonGroup|PushButton|ComboBox|ListBox|SelectionTree|GroupBox|Line|Bitmap|ScrollableText`. Native Windows Installer Control table type. |
| `X` | `integer` | **Yes** | `20` | Horizontal position in MSI dialog units (`0..370`). |
| `Y` | `integer` | **Yes** | `60` | Vertical position in MSI dialog units (`0..270`). |
| `Width` | `integer` | **Yes** | `330` | Control width in MSI dialog units. |
| `Height` | `integer` | **Yes** | `18` | Control height in MSI dialog units. |
| `Property` | `string` | No | — | MSI Property bound to this control (automatically added to `SecureCustomProperties` if uppercase!). |
| `DefaultValue` | `string` | No | — | Optional initial value written to the MSI `Property` table. |
| `Text` | `string` | No | — | Control label or rich text (`{\DlgFontBold8}...`). |
| `Items` | `string` | No | — | Pipe-separated `Value:Caption` entries for `RadioButtonGroup`, `ComboBox`, or `ListBox` controls. |

## 3. `.rsis` Multi-Project Suite Schema (Optional — Like Visual Studio `.slnx`)

```ini
[Suite]
Name          = Acme Enterprise Suite
Version       = 1.0.0
Architectures = arm64|x64

[Variable]
PUBLISHER     = Acme Corporation

[Project.CoreMsm]
Path          = shared\core-runtime.rsip
Category      = MergeModules
BuildOrder    = 10

[Project.DesktopApp]
Path          = apps\desktop-client.rsip
Category      = CoreApps
BuildOrder    = 20
```

## 4. Minimal Annotated `.rsip` Project Example

```ini
; Sample RaggieSoft Installer Project (.rsip) — builds both x64 and arm64!
[Package]
Name              = Hello App
Tagline           = Fast, Accessible Native Windows Application
Version           = 1.0.0
Manufacturer      = Acme Open Source
UpgradeCode       = {A18F4E20-7C93-4D62-9B44-524147474945}
Architecture      = $(ARCH)
BuildBootstrapper = true

[Install]
DefaultSubdir     = Acme\Hello App
MainExecutable    = HelloApp.exe

[UI]
WizardLayout      = standard
AccentPrimaryHex  = #2563EB
AccentSecondaryHex= #FBBF24
LicenseRtf        = License.rtf
InstallButtonText = &Install

[Payload.App]
Source            = ..\..\bin\$(ARCH)\HelloApp.exe

[Shortcut.StartMenu]
Name              = Hello App
TargetFile        = HelloApp.exe
Location          = StartMenu
Description       = Launch Hello App
```
